content: उशनस् {%m.%} [वश्-कनसि संप्र˚ <ls>Uṇ. 4. 238</ls>] (<ab>Nom.</ab> <ab>sing.</ab> उशना; <ab>Voc.</ab> <ab>sing.</ab> उशनन्, उशन, उशनः) <ab>N.</ab> of Śukra, regent of the planet Venus, son of Bhṛgu and preceptor of the Asuras. In the Vedas he has the epithet (or patronymic name) {%Kāvya%} given to him, probably because he was noted for his wisdom; मित्रावरुणावुशनां काव्यम् (अवथः) <ls>Av. 4. 29. 6</ls>. <ab>cf.</ab> कवीनामुशना कविः <ls>Bg. 10. 37</ls>; He is also known as a writer on civil and religious law (<ls>Y. 1. 4</ls>). and as an authority on civil polity; शास्त्रमुशनसा प्रणीतम् <ls>Pt. 5</ls>; अध्यापितस्योशनसापि नीतिम् <ls>Ku. 3. 6</ls>.
